DISTRIBUTABLE.definition: Freely packaged and shipped to end users in the downloadable evaluation bundle. Contains no trade secrets or proprietary algorithmic source code.

components.name: web-frontend-compiled
components.nature: Next.js 16 standalone production build, strictly stripped of .map source maps
components.shipped_format: Compiled container / Standalone Node.js server bundle

components.name: synthetic-demo-corpus
components.nature: 100% synthetic hardware specifications and security whitepapers with ground-truth QA maps

components.name: demo-launchers-and-scripts
components.nature: PowerShell and Bash orchestration scripts (start, stop, status, verify, reset)

components.name: evaluation-public-key
components.nature: Ed25519 public key for local verification of signed evaluation licenses

components.name: evaluation-documentation
components.nature: Getting started, architecture overview, security advisory, and evaluation agreements

RESTRICTED.definition: Packaged with restrictions or interfaces that mediator access between the user's local instance and the central evaluation gateway. Protected by rate limits and device tokens.

components.name: local-reverse-proxy
components.nature: Nginx configuration routing frontend requests to the Evaluation Gateway with header injection

components.name: evaluation-client-sdk
components.nature: Lightweight client for signing requests, validating local license, and reporting heartbeat
components.shipped_format: Embedded in demo proxy / local runner

components.name: demo-manifest-and-contracts
components.nature: Package integrity manifest with SHA-256 digests and version tags

PRIVATE.definition: PROPRIETARY AND CONFIDENTIAL. Core intellectual property, mathematical algorithms, optimization models, and server infrastructure. NEVER included in downloadable packages.

components.name: submodular-context-optimizer
components.nature: Submodular knapsack context selection, diversity budgeting, and token-entropy packing
components.protection_mechanism: Hosted exclusively on private infrastructure behind Evaluation Gateway

components.name: sheaf-topology-engine
components.nature: Sheaf Laplacian spectral decomposition, multi-document topological consistency graphs
components.protection_mechanism: Hosted exclusively on private infrastructure behind Evaluation Gateway

components.name: governance-contradiction-engine
components.nature: Abstract interpretation, invariant propagation, and deliberate contradiction detection
components.protection_mechanism: Hosted exclusively on private infrastructure behind Evaluation Gateway

components.name: memory-hypergraph-orchestrator
components.nature: Hierarchical document memory hypergraph, persistent indexing, and causal tracing
components.protection_mechanism: Hosted exclusively on private infrastructure behind Evaluation Gateway

components.name: gateway-root-private-key
components.nature: Ed25519 root private key used to sign evaluation licenses and issue device tokens
components.protection_mechanism: KMS / HSM / Secure server-side vault only

components.name: provider-credentials-and-internal-apis
components.nature: LLM API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), DB connection strings, admin routes
components.protection_mechanism: Strict exclusion via .dockerignore, .gitignore, and build stripping

THIRD_PARTY.definition: External libraries and components with distinct licensing obligations that must be respected.

components.name: PyMuPDF / fitz
components.compliance_strategy: Isolated in standalone aegis-docprep or invoked via clean CLI subprocess boundary

components.name: FastAPI / Uvicorn / Pydantic / Cryptography
components.compliance_strategy: Standard attribution included in release manifests
